static: harsh analog VHS tape static, loud white noise hiss with crackle and a low hum, a tape ending on a blank channel
glitch: a very short VHS tape tracking glitch: a warbling distorted electrical crackle and a brief buzz
mall_hum: an empty shopping mall at night, low steady air conditioning drone and faint fluorescent light hum, no people, no music, no footsteps, loopable
tape_hiss: constant soft analog videotape hiss and faint mechanical motor whir, steady, loopable
breath: one slow quiet human exhale very close to a microphone, muffled, no voice
scrape: a small tin toy robot scraping out from under a metal shop shutter onto a stone floor
tick_walk: a wind-up tin toy robot walking on a hard floor: steady mechanical clockwork ticking and tiny metal footsteps, loopable
whir: a clockwork spring winding down and stopping with a click, small toy
clank: a small tin toy robot stopping: a light metallic clank
eyes: two tiny toy light bulbs switching on with a soft electric click and a faint hum
shutter: a metal roller shutter on a shop front jolting up a foot by itself: a loud rattle and clank, then stillness
flicker: a fluorescent tube light flickering on and off with sharp electrical clicks and a stuttering buzz
swell: a slow rising horror tension swell, reversed cymbal and dissonant strings rising to a sudden stop
sting: a sudden loud analog horror jump scare stinger: a violent burst of distorted VHS static with a deep low impact and a harsh metallic screech, very loud, then cut
roll: a VHS tape tracking roll: a warbling wow and flutter distortion with a rushing hiss
store_hum: a small closed clothing store at night: quiet ventilation hum and a faint fluorescent light buzz, no people, no music, loopable
tin_step: one single step of a heavy tin wind-up toy robot on a hard stone floor: a hollow metallic clack with a tiny clockwork click, close, dry, no music
drag: a small tin toy foot dragged slowly across a hard stone floor: a thin dry metal scrape, close, in a silent empty hall
tick_rundown: the clockwork inside a tin wind-up toy running down: steady metallic ticking that gets slower and slower and slower, then one last click and silence
tick_fast: the clockwork motor of a tin wind-up toy racing much too fast: frantic rapid metallic ticking and whirring gears, close, loopable
wind_self: a big metal wind-up key on a tin toy turning slowly by itself: a heavy ratchet, one loud click at a time with pauses between, the spring creaking tighter
head_snap: a tin toy robot's metal head twisting round very fast on its neck: a short harsh grinding metal screech ending in a hard click
toys_wake: dozens of wind-up toys starting all at once behind a closed metal shop shutter: a muffled chaotic chorus of clockwork whirring, ticking and tiny squeaking gears
sting_toy: a sudden extremely loud horror jump scare hit: a deep heavy impact, a harsh distorted metal screech and a broken toy voice box shriek, with a burst of VHS static, then cut
